description.value: Enhanced Item. A shattered shard of a holocron, still humming faintly with a captured gatekeeper intelligence. Spend 8 hours in quiet meditation or study with the fragment attuned to you, and you unlock a single fragmentary lesson: choose one 1st-level Force power you do not know from any class's list. You may cast that power once without expending a Force point; after that, the fragment's stored knowledge fades until you complete a long rest.
